node.title: Conjecture-F prize consumer flat-scope compiler
node.statement: Enumerate every actual LIST/MCA call to Conjecture-F flatness, including coordinate-prefix, Hankel/split-pencil, and mixed-petal received-word/Pade families. Emit an exact multiplicity-preserving descriptor with domain, locator degree j, projective dimension r, root threshold, punctures, and first-owner chronology. Prove that each descriptor is paid or lies in the quantitative regime consumed by the global packing theorem, and that the inventory is exhaustive. The refuted two-family scope and an unqualified all-linear-flats claim are not substitutes.
node.attack_surface: audit graph call sites, compile the mixed-petal Pade descriptor, and pin the quantitative dimension gap and first-owner transport
node.falsifier: an actual prize call omitted from the inventory, a near-full-dimensional unowned descriptor outside the packing regime, or a transport losing multiplicity or ownership
